description: Workflow runs across all repos. Filter by category, repo, workflow name, status, and job type.

panels.title: Queue Depth & In-Progress Runs
panels.description: Org-wide queued and in-progress workflow run counts over time, across every category (e2e, lint, ci, automation, release) -- the same signals the HighQueueDepth and SustainedQueueBacklog alerts fire on. Native Prometheus gauges, not filtered by this dashboard's category/repo/workflow/machine variables since the underlying metric is already org-wide. e2e runs on self-hosted runners, a completely different resource pool from the GitHub-hosted runners every other category uses, and can dwarf-or-be-dwarfed-by the combined total here -- see "E2E Queue Depth & In-Progress Runs" below for that queue specifically.

panels.title: E2E Queue Depth & In-Progress Runs
panels.description: Same signal as "Queue Depth & In-Progress Runs" above, scoped to category=e2e only -- e2e runs on this fleet's self-hosted runners (a fixed-size pool: ~16 hosts), a completely different resource from the GitHub-hosted runners every other category uses, so its own queue depth is what actually indicates whether the self-hosted fleet needs more capacity. Not filtered by this dashboard's category/repo/workflow/machine variables, same reason as the panel above -- the underlying metric is already org-wide (by design, so this panel always shows e2e specifically regardless of what the category dropdown is set to). Y-axis capped at 100 for now -- revisit if the fleet's runner-instance count changes enough to make that ceiling wrong.
